## Recovered observations

167 points (107 from F4-19; 60 from F4-20) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-s4-b1`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

Panel 1: Past 100 ms the printed time labels skip 110: the evenly spaced lines after the 100 ms line are labeled 120, 130 and 140 and the frame after them is unlabeled. The values read those lines as 110, 120 and 130 ms and the frame as 140 ms, from the even spacing. Taken as printed, a time between the 100 ms line and the next would be up to 10 ms later (the difference grows across that interval) and every later time 10 ms later. Fig. 4-20 cannot test this: the same rescaling of both time axes leaves force against displacement unchanged.

Panel 2: Past 100 ms the printed time labels skip 110: the evenly spaced lines after the 100 ms line are labeled 120, 130 and 140 and the frame after them is unlabeled. Taken as printed, a time between the 100 ms line and the next would be up to 10 ms later (the difference grows across that interval) and every later time 10 ms later. Fig. 4-20 cannot test this: the same rescaling of both time axes leaves force against displacement unchanged.

Panel 3: derived-from F4-19; Fig. 4-20 plots the force of panel 1 against the displacement of panel 2: the same runs, cross-plotted from the same records.

Panel 3, run4: the line is broken after claude sample 24: scan dropout: no ink from about 1.78 to 1.84 in (both readers); the line is not drawn across it.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Run No. 4 is plotted in F4-19 (Dr = 0), F4-20 and F4-21 (M1 = 31 lbs.; Relative Density = 0); the F4-20 and F4-21 traces agree in shape and end near 4.1 inch. State from the F4-21 caption (RS Loose Soil). Velocity printed only as about six fps; unit weight, gp, gravity and bed preparation not printed. M1 31 lbs. is below the rig minimum of about 32 pounds (text 3-22, PDF 163). Bed size is the rig bed of Section III, not stated per run.
- Codex: M1 = 31 lbs. Same run in three figures. Text says six-inch pad. Exact impact speed, bed unit weight and Gp unreported. Earth gravity inferred.
